description: This file defines a React functional component 'Fallbacks' used in a UI to manage fallback models, including testing fallback responses, displaying fallback configurations, and enabling deletion of fallback entries. It interacts with external APIs and components for notifications, networking, and UI rendering.

methods.name: testFallbackModelResponse
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the response of a specified AI model fallback by making a chat completion request and displaying success or error notifications.
